objective: Best validation-selected performance obtained within a fixed two-hour A10 training budget per run, not performance restricted to the final training state.
selection_rule: Minimum recorded sampled validation cross-entropy within each dropout 0.2 training run; no checkpoint selection using test results.
scope: All three dropout 0.2 models requested by the user. This is not a claim that dropout 0.2 won across all configurations; small dropout 0.1 had slightly lower sampled validation loss.
evaluation: Teacher-forced next-token cross-entropy; evaluate every token except the first token of each piece once. Consecutive non-overlapping target blocks of up to 1024 tokens reset context at block boundaries and never cross piece boundaries. Include EOS, exclude right-padding targets.
aggregation: Token-weighted negative log likelihood in natural-log units (nats/token); perplexity is exp(cross_entropy). Per-piece and per-event-family diagnostics use the same scored targets.
inference: model.eval(), inference_mode, BF16 autocast on A10; no training or optimizer updates.
interpretation: Full-coverage validation loss is recomputed with the same protocol as test; it differs from the original sampled-window checkpoint-selection metric. Single-seed findings are descriptive, not significance tests.
